note: Myanmar: Singapore's citizens enter without a visa for 30 days; Russia's, Belarus's and Vietnam's for 30 days and the rest of ASEAN's (Malaysia's since 1 October 2025) for 14, for tourism through the Yangon, Nay Pyi Taw or Mandalay airports. China, Hong Kong and India take a visa on arrival (30 days; Japan's, Macao's and Korea's arrangement ran to 21 October 2026 and has lapsed). Everyone else applies for an e-Visa online (tourist stay up to 28 days). Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Ministry of Immigration and Population's rules.
